from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):

        self.play(GrowArrow(i_hat), GrowArrow(j_hat))

        self.wait(0.3)

        self.play(Transform(grid_base, scaled_grid_points), run_time=0.5)

            run_time=1.5
        )

        arm_end_dot = Dot(arm_line2.get_end(), radius=0.06, color=COLOR_ROBOT)
        
        def robot_updater(m):
            p1 = base_p
            a1 = ang1.get_value()
            p2 = p1 + np.array([np.cos(a1), np.sin(a1), 0]) * arm_len1
            a2 = a1 + ang2.get_value()
            p3 = p2 + np.array([np.cos(a2), np.sin(a2), 0]) * arm_len2
            
            m[0].put_start_and_end_on(p1, p2)
            m[1].put_start_and_end_on(p2, p3)
            m[2].move_to(p2)
            m[3].move_to(p3)

        robot_vgroup = VGroup(arm_line1, arm_line2, arm_joint_dot, arm_end_dot)
        robot_vgroup.add_updater(robot_updater)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(robot_vgroup))
        self.play(ang1.animate.set_value(5*PI/6), ang2.animate.set_value(PI/2), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(ang1.animate.set_value(PI/2), ang2.animate.set_value(-PI/4), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(robot_vgroup))
        
        # Geometric Eye text
        eye_text = Text("Geometric Eye", color=COLOR_GEOMETRIC_EYE, font_size=44)
        self.place_in_area(eye_text, "B2", "E5")
        eye_glow = eye_text.copy().set_stroke(width=8, opacity=0.3)
        
        self.play(Write(eye_text), FadeIn(eye_glow))
        self.play(Indicate(eye_text, color=COLOR_GEOMETRIC_EYE))
        
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Reset color
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
